title: Cashier Computation Sheet: Marlowe & Finch Alterations Deposit Before Work
content:
**Clause.** The deposit a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket owes before the tailor starts the work is computed as follows.

1. **Owed or not.** A deposit is owed only on a ticket in a class whose deposit percentage is above 0; a class whose deposit percentage is not above 0 takes no deposit.
2. **Standing charges.** The ticket's standing charges are every charge booked on the ticket — operations, lined surcharges, the rush fee and extra fittings — less every waiver booked on it.
3. **Deposit percentage.** The deposit percentage is the deposit rate, plus the uncollected-order addition, less the garment-tender, frequent-shopper and cardmember reductions, and never below 0. On this computation the deposit rate is the class's deposit percentage and there is no addition and no reduction.
4. **Assembly from the deposit form.** The deposit is assembled from its form:
   - under the per-operation form it is 40.00 USD for each operation charge on the ticket, at least the class's minimum deposit and never more than the standing charges;
   - under the two-part form it is the class's minimum deposit plus the deposit percentage of the standing charges above 250.00 USD;
   - under the percentage form it is the deposit percentage of the standing charges, at least the class's minimum deposit and never more than the standing charges.

   The deposit is rounded half up to the cent once, on that final figure — a figure at or above the half-cent mark, or within 0.0001 of a cent below it, goes up to the next cent. Where a floor and a ceiling both apply, the figure is first raised to the minimum when below it, then reduced to the standing charges when above them.

On this computation the deposit takes the percentage form.

## Worked examples, percentage form (hypothetical figures: deposit percentage 40, minimum 60.00 USD)

| Standing charges | 40 percent, rounded | After the minimum | After the ceiling | Deposit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 300.00 USD | 120.00 USD | 120.00 USD | 120.00 USD | 120.00 USD |
| 100.00 USD | 40.00 USD | 60.00 USD | 60.00 USD | 60.00 USD |
| 45.00 USD | 18.00 USD | 60.00 USD | 45.00 USD | 45.00 USD |

## The other forms, worked (same hypothetical figures)

- Per-operation form, 3 operation charges, standing charges 300.00 USD: 3 multiplied by 40.00 is 120.00 USD; deposit 120.00 USD. With 1 operation charge: 40.00 USD, raised to the 60.00 USD minimum.
- Two-part form, standing charges 400.00 USD: 60.00 USD plus 40 percent of 150.00 USD, that is 120.00 USD.

**Standing charges from the ticket (hypothetical).** Operation charges of 145.00 and 75.00 USD, a lined surcharge of 36.25 USD, a rush fee of 40.00 USD and one waiver of 20.00 USD give standing charges of 145.00 plus 75.00 plus 36.25 plus 40.00, less 20.00, that is 276.25 USD.
